extracted.intended_audience: public relations and communications professionals (PR Newswire members, marketers, PR practitioners)
extracted.subtask_description: A knowledge-center style overview of public relations best practices and tactics for press releases, online PR, investor relations, multimedia broadcast, and social media. The page links how‑to articles, white papers and FAQs intended to help practitioners plan and execute effective communications campaigns.

rubrics_metrics.name: Knowledge Center purpose
rubrics_metrics.description: The purpose of the Knowledge Center is to offer public relations advice and strategies, how-to articles, thought leadership pieces and other information to help you make your public relations, investor relations, marketing and multimedia broadcast campaigns more effective.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Here you’ll find the latest information on everything from online public relations to multimedia broadcast PR. If you don’t see the information you need here, reach out to us. Our experts are always available to help you reach your communications goals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Principles of strong communications
rubrics_metrics.description: The principles of strong communications haven’t changed, but the way campaigns are executed is evolving in the new media age. Interactive media is leveling the playing field and the rules of success are still emerging.
